firstPlayerRule: Whoever most recently served dessert to the group in real life goes first.
houseFallback: If this criterion does not suit your group, agree to choose randomly. This is a house rule.
clarifications: Serving dessert selects the starter; simply being the most recent person to eat dessert does not.
